name: Lateral Line Hop
steps: Stand beside a floor line with your feet close together and knees slightly bent.
Push through both feet and hop sideways just far enough to clear the line.
Land on both feet and immediately spring back across the line.
Continue linking hops from side to side, then bend your knees to settle the final landing.
tips: Keep your chest facing forward throughout the drill.
Keep the hops low so you can rebound quickly.
